title: Secondary Infektion
excerpt: Six-year Russian campaign that planted forged documents on 300+ platforms; almost all fell flat, except leaked UK–US trade papers in 2019.
excerptEs: Campaña rusa de seis años que sembró documentos falsos en más de 300 plataformas; casi todo pasó inadvertido salvo la filtración comercial británica de 2019.

sources.title: Graphika, "Exposing Secondary Infektion: Forgeries, Interference, and Attacks on Kremlin Critics" (16 June 2020)
Atlantic Council DFRLab, "Operation Secondary Infektion: A Suspected Russian Intelligence Operation" (22 June 2019)
Graphika (Ben Nimmo), "UK Trade Leaks and Secondary Infektion: New Findings and Insights from a Known Russian Operation" (December 2019)
